cases.required_evidence: Replay exact committed schedule/page against its original durable journal and receipt; independently show logical/native state unchanged and no additional table or manifest commit/version.
Close original owned process; reopen in a fresh process using the retained journal and source positions; prove exact state/vector/recovery with no extra commit or source ACK.

Inject or observe bounded uncertain outcome, retain the exact original operation reference and request custody, and show no new prepare/apply/request retry; reconcile only that reference or fail closed before later mutation/ACK.

On a separate isolated test copy, with required journal absent, prove restart refuses before graph table effects, later source mutation, or either source ACK; retain refusal and unchanged baseline evidence.
Submit a separately pinned unadmitted breaking candidate and prove refusal before data/manifest effects and before either source ACK; confirm prior publication remains unchanged.

Within the explicitly declared original read/retention interval, read the exact historical complete vector UUID/version and compare independent source-derived object/edge/history/tombstone/progress values; preserve the old publication while later prefixes exist.

Separately, after the declared retention/version interval expires or from an intentionally absent exact version, verify explicit refusal and no fallback to latest. This negative case does not replace CE-06.

controls: Use isolated test copies or inert fault ports for refusal tests; do not corrupt the sole retained source or journal.
All evidence must bind the frozen schedule digest, accepted A/B source/model pins, installation registry, exact source progress and complete publication vectors.
Run sequentially under separately bounded, explicitly authorized conditions; this draft authorizes no native tests.
scope: Required closure controls for the selected R04 run; this register defines evidence and ordering, not permission to execute.
